title: Skeleton
summary: A shimmering placeholder with the shape of the content it stands in for. Use it while a page, card or list is loading; use Spinner for a short wait on an action.

demos.title: Shapes
demos.note: A skeleton has no size of its own. Give it the height, width and radius of the thing it stands in for: a line of text, an avatar, a tag, an image.

demos.title: Text
demos.note: Vary the line widths and end on a short one, so it reads as a paragraph and not a block.

demos.title: List rows
demos.note: Repeat the row shape a few times. Three or four rows are enough to say a list is coming.

demos.title: Matching the content
demos.note: The skeleton takes the layout of what is coming, so nothing jumps when it arrives. Skeletons are hidden from screen readers; mark the container aria-busy.
